summary: Install argcomplete with pipx inject --include-apps ansible argcomplete, or pip install --user argcomplete.
questions: How do I install argcomplete for Ansible?

answer_card.title: Install argcomplete
answer_card.answer_md:
pipx install: `pipx inject --include-apps ansible argcomplete`

pip install: `python3 -m pip install --user argcomplete`
